start2.title: Training ground
start2.text: Scobby: [Aight, let me teach you how to fight as a hunter before we depart. The monsters out there are way more dangerous than normal ants, and I need you to watch my back when the time comes.]

opt.text: Time for some sparring, I guess
I already know about fighting properly

sparring.title: Training ground
sparring.text:
Scobby: [Let's learn about the basics of combat.]

Scobby: [On the top right, you'll see a button that you can click to access your profile. You can see your known movesets under movesets in that profile screen. These are the moves that you are able to perform in combat.]

Scobby: [Since you are not very skilled in fighting yet, you will have trouble dealing damage. Let me teach you an offensive move.

You learn <Bash>!

Scobby: [You will need to use the skill <Engage> to get close to me before you can use <Bash>.]

Scobby: [Use your new skill to try to deal damage to me. Let's spar!]

sparring2.title: Training ground
sparring2.text:
Scobby: [No offense, but you are almost as weak as Cheese... anyways, let's go over the moves you used.]

Scobby: [As you experienced, you have 3 random skills to choose from your knowledge pool each turn. When you use up all of the skills from the pool, you had the option to 'Gather yourself' and re-stock all of the skills. Also, you may have noticed that only the skill that is currently usable is shown to you. For example, you don't have the option to kick me when disengaged.]

Scobby: [Now, let me teach you to be a fighter.]

sparring3.title: Training ground
sparring3.text:
Hours pass. It is now %time.

Scobby: [Phew, now you're a little more of a hunter. Let me give you one last instruction about targeting before we move on.]

sparring skip.title: Training ground
sparring skip.text:
Scobby: [...Are you sure? Fine. Let me at least teach you a combat skill.]

Scobby: [Wind up buffs up your next attack to deal double damage.
Cripple deals 1 damage and make them unable to move for 3 turns.
Charge allows you to engage and deal 1 damage when disengaged.]

sparring end.title: Field
sparring end.text:
Today is the day of departure.
You eat as much as you can at the feast of Full Moon's Journey.
The people of Ant Hill wave goodbye as you, Cheese, and Scobby leave Ant Hill through a dirt road sprinked with flower petals.

Your group spend the whole day traveling North through the forests until you see a body of water blocking the way.

Scobby: [This is the river that separates our land from northern foreign lands. There are many hostile monsters on the other side of this river... lot more than around Ant Hill.]

Scobby: [Let's build a camp here so we can construct a raft to cross the river.]

river camp.title: River side camp
river camp.text:
You are at camp. Scobby is busy building a raft.

Scobby: [Please get me some sturdy woods while you are out scouting. Be careful after dark.]

river scout.title: River side
river scout.text:
Just as you leave camp to scout, Cheese comes running towards you.

Cheese: [Can I come with? I want some adventure too!]

river scout1-1.title: River side
river scout1-1.text:
Cheese joins you.

You start scouting around the camp.

Cheese: [I heard you tried to fight a wolf spider. How did that go?]

You tell him about your story.

Cheese: [Wow, you are pretty weak!]

You hear a sound.

river scout1-2.title: River side
river scout1-2.text:
Cheese joins you.

You and Cheese scout around for a while.

Cheese: [I hope we run into something dangerous. I always wanted to be a hunter, but my father is a lame-ass priest.]

You hear something.

river scout2-1.title: River side
river scout2-1.text: You scout the woods along the river. This area is pretty humid, which means there are dangerous predators nearby... Actually, you hear one coming your way right now.

river scout3.title: River side
river scout3.text:
You are still out in the woods.
It is %time.

river scout4-1.title: River side
river scout4-1.text: You are walking around in the woods again. You hear something.

river scout4-2.title: River side
river scout4-2.text: You are walking around in the woods again. You hear something.

river defeat.title: River side
river defeat.text:
You are unconscious.

...
Something is gently shaking you...

You open your eyes and see Scobby's ugly face.

Scobby: [Are you alright? You should rest here for a bit.
When you are defeated in battle, you lose some knowledge and equipment. Be careful next time.]

Every bone in your body ache.

river scout4-3.title: River side
river scout4-3.text: You walk around the woods and find a sturdy wood.

opt.text: Pick it up and go back to camp

river quest done.title: River
river quest done.text:
You provide the sturdy wood.
It is %time.

Scobby: [The raft is done... Let's get rowing.]%temp

---

You row your way across the river.

Scobby: [So, according to the map, this river will take about 2 hours to cross. Cheese, please stop touching the water. We don't want to attract fish.]

Scobby: [Let's take this time to talk about our mission. Do you have any questions for me?]

ask mission.title: River
ask mission.text:
Scobby: [5 years ago, Ant Hill used to trade food and crafts with the neighboring settlements. There were people dying from monster attacks and such, but nowhere as dangerous as it is now.
But then the roads suddenly became very dangerous. So dangerous, that we don't even know what is happening outside, let alone trading.

They tried coordinating hunter groups to clear the road, but they would get massacred by wolf spiders who attack with even bigger numbers...]

Scobby: [Later in that year, the priest and the leaders of Ant Hill decided to gather and choose 2 people to leave and contact our old neighbors. It's incredibly dangerous, but understandable... we can't just sit and do nothing.
If we can somehow resume trade, we can import things like crossbows and destructive spells to defend ourselves better.]

Scobby: [I am willing to die for Ant Hill, and I hope you are, too.]

ask hunting.title: River
ask hunting.text:
Scobby: [As you know, the main source of food in Ant Hill is meat from hunted bugs. Ant Hill has always been thriving ever since we had conquered the hill from the fire ants, thanks to us hunters who provide plenty of meat to the market in Ant Hill. Although, nowadays our population has been stagnant due to people constantly being ambushed and kidnapped...

But anyways, most of the men in Ant Hill are hunters like me, and you should sooner or later learn how to hunt.]

Scobby: [The last hunter sent out before us was Arly. She was a pretty good hunter, very skilled at hunting with axes. She was once just a scout like you, but she had learned how to fight and became a hunter.]

Scobby gives you one of those looks.

Scobby: [She hasn't returned from the Journey, and it will probably be the same for us, too. But it will be an honorable death.]

Cheese: [Nah... I'm pretty sure she and all the other pilgrims went to someplace nicer than Ant Hill and forgot about us. No way all of those people just died.]

other side.title: Other side
other side.text:
The three of you arrive on the other side of the river. You see dozens of weird flying monsters that you don't recognize above the riverbed in the distance.

Cheese: [So what's out here that makes people never return?]

Scobby: [Well... spiders, mantis, rats, bloodquito... could be anything, really. Even the most skilled hunter can't constantly fight off bloodquitos without proper rest.]

Scobby: [Our goal is Stone Henge, which might take more than 4 days of walking. Our best option is stealth. Let's just hope we don't run into something big.]

Scobby: [Also.. if we get defeated in battle, we'll have to retreat here and start over again. Remember that when you are defeated, one random move from your moveset will be turned useless. If you run out of engaging moves, it may as well be game over, and you'd have to start over by accessing the Chapters menu in your profile. Let's move.]

journey defeat.title: River side
journey defeat.text:
You are unconscious.

...
Your sides ache, as if being struck by a pole...

You open your eyes. Scobby is sitting on a tree trunk and poking you with a stick.

Scobby: [You awake? you really need to bulk up, kid.]

Every bone in your body ache.

day 1.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1.text:
This is the first day of travel towards Stone Henge.
You lead the team through the wilderness, trying your best to bypass danger.

Scobby: [I don't remember those goldenrod flowers growing along this road. I think it might be better to go around it, even if it takes longer.]

Cheese: [No, it'll be a good view. Why take the long route? Do you guys like walking that much?]

day 1-2.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-2.text:
You decide to walk through the forest of goldenrod flowers. Those flowers are towering over your head, at least 3 times as tall as you are and blooming with menacing yellow petals. Pollen dust and yellow petals dance with gentle breeze.

Cheese: [Guys, my legs hurt. Why don't we take lunch here in the beautiful scenary?]

day 1-3.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-3.text:
You, Cheese, and Scobby start cooking some ant steak on Cheese's frying pan while enjoying the beautiful golden scenery.
Unfortunately, the smell of food brought a guest.

day 1-4.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-4.text: You continue through the foliage. On and on, you see nothing but golden bloom, waving left to right in the wind... It's almost like they are moving... Wait, they are!

day 1 end.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 1 end.text:
You walk all day long. It is getting dark.

Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling!]

Scobby: [Cheese, you won't have to be on watch so you'll at least get plenty of sleep.]

Cheese: [If we stop now, I'll be on watch for 3 hours tonight. Please?]

Scobby: [No... I don't think so.]

opt.to: >save>temp>Cheese, your legs will never improve if you keep whining like that. We should continue.>day 2

day 1 end-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 1 end-1.text:
You leave Cheese on watch and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to Scobby's muffled screams. You see that there is a giant blood red tick wrapped around his face. There is blood everywhere.

Scobby: [ARRRRGGHHHH!!!!!]

You see that Cheese is sleeping.

day 2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2.text:
It is the second day.
You reach a clearing of green, grassy fields.

Scobby: [Blue skies, green fields, soft winds, this is the joy of travel.]

Cheese: [Of course. Can we rest now?]

Scobby: [Cheese, we've only been walking for 2 hours. If we rest here, we will have to travel in the dark.]

day 2-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1.text:
It is %time.
The three of you trail through the woods.

Cheese: [You know, it's kinda quiet here. And my legs have been sore for three days, so...]

day 2-2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-2.text:
Couple minutes have passed, and now it is time to go. You turn to see that Scobby has fallen asleep.
You don't see Cheese anywhere.

opt.text: Wake Scobby up and leave without Cheese

day 2-1-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-1.text:
Cheese: [Guys, don't leave without me!]

Scobby: [Cheese, how many times do I have to tell you not to shout? You got a death wish, boy?]

You hear a buzzing sound.

day 2-1-2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-2.text:
You go around shouting for Cheese. You find him behind a tree not far from you.

Cheese: [What? Can't I take a dump in peace?]

There is a giant bloodquito sitting on the tree, silently gazing down at him.

day 2-1-3.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-3.text:
You look around for Cheese.
You find him behind a tree... Wait, that's a mouse.

day 2 end1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end1.text:
It is getting dark.

Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling... I'll really be on watch this time, I swear.]

Scobby: [%temp]

day 2 end2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end2.text:
It is getting dark.

Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling!]

Scobby: [Cheese... not this again.]

Cheese: [If we stop now, I'll be on watch for 3 hours tonight. Please?]

day 2 end2-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end2-1.text:
You leave Cheese on watch and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to Scobby's painful screams.
You see that there are two bloodquitos sucking blood out of his left arm and right arm, respectively. There is blood everywhere.

Scobby: [ARRRRGGHHHH!!!!!]

Cheese: [Scobby, shut up! I'm trying to sleep.].

day 3-1.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3-1.text:
It is the third day.
Scobby: [We are on our third day. Just two more days of walking and we'll be at Stone Henge.]

Cheese: [Yea, we could maybe spend an extra day resting. It's not good to walk this much.]

Walking down a green valley, you see a giant blue beetle grazing on the grass.

Scobby: [Hey, that's a blue beetle. If we hunt that, I'll craft you a nice weapon.]

day 3-2.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3-2.text:
It is the third day.
Scobby: [I am very sick... I hope we don't get attacked.]

Cheese: [I'm sorry.]

Scobby: [Please lead us through the safest route.]

Walking down a green valley, you see a giant blue beetle grazing on the grass. You remember Scobby telling you that he can craft good weapons out of blue beetle chitin.

day 3 end.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3 end.text:
It is getting dark.

Scobby: [We should rest early today and give our wounds some time to heal. If memory serves me right, we will be entering the woods again tomorrow.]

day 4.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4.text:
Today is the last day of travel to Stone Henge.
Your group trails through a forest of deciduous trees.

Cheese: [Now is usually around the time when we get ambushed by wildlife.]

Scobby: [Wait, I hear something.]

You look around and see nothing.
Suddenly, you hear frenzied shouting from all around. You are ambushed by 4 people in rags wielding spears!

day 4 2-1.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 2-1.text:
Scobby inspects the corpses of the feral humans.

Scobby: [Hmm... this is weird. These people are wearing rags and wielding primitive weapons, and don't seem to understand us, like some kind of animals... just like the ferals in the Spider Forest that you spoke of. Cheese, for Gaia's sake, don't defile the corpses!]

Scobby: [We should bury the corpses under leaves here and mark it. We'll notify Stone Henge of this...]

Cheese: [Can I carry around this corpse? She's... I just... never mind.]

You proceed to Stone Henge.

day 4 2-2.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 2-2.text:
Scobby inspects the corpses of the feral humans.

Scobby: [Hmm... this is weird. These people wear rags and bark, like some kind of animals. Cheese, for Gaia's sake, don't defile the corpses!]

Scobby: [We should bury the corpses under leaves here and mark it. We'll notify Stone Henge of this.. hopefully nothing has happned to Stone Henge.]

Cheese: [Can I carry around this corpse? She's... I just... never mind.]

You proceed to Stone Henge.

day 4 3.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 3.text:
You leave the forest and walk through a clearing for a while. You see a massive stone structure in the distance.

Scobby: [It looks like we had Mother Gaia's blessings. We are at Stone Henge, and in one piece!]

Cheese: [So this is the journey that everyone failed to make for 5 years? I'm pretty sure the other scouts just abandoned Ant Hill.]

Scobby: [It could be that we're just lucky. But let's be careful, just in case.]

You see in a distance what looks like a pile of large stones. Walking closer, it looks like a giant structure made of huge stone bricks had collapsed. Could it be that Stone Henge was destroyed?

Scobby: [Ah, Stone Henge, looking just as magnificent as it did 8 years ago when I visited! Let's visit the priest of Stone Henge and let him know that we've arrived from Ant Hill.]

stone henge.title: Stone Henge
stone henge.text:
It is %time.

You stand in the middle of the busy streets of Stone Henge. Giant stone bricks above cast shadows all over, creating a cool atmosphere protected from the sun.
Like Ant Hill, there are hunters selling meat on display everywhere. Unlike Ant Hill, people don't seem surprised by the presence of new faces.

stone henge temple.title: Stone Henge Temple
stone henge temple.text:
Scobby: [We come from Ant Hill. Where is the temple?]

Stone Henge Guard: [A visitor? follow me.]

Cheese: [Do you get a lot of visitors from outside? we get none.]

The guard did not bother to answer Cheese.

You walk up stone stairs going up one of those massive stone bricks. You walked up almost a hundred steps to get to the temple, which was on the third layer of those stone bricks. The temple is just an open area on one of the bricks, with a nice shade cast by another stone brick above.

Priest: [Welcome! you come from Ant Hill? We had not heard from Ant Hill for a while, and we were worried about you.]

Cheese: [You don't sound worried.]

Priest: [...]

stone henge affairs.title: Stone Henge Temple
stone henge affairs.text:
Priest: [We get by. We too, have lost trade with our neighbors, but we do get visitors... But anyways, I'm sure you are all exhausted from your long trip. We have a guest house for valued guests like you that you can stay for as long as you wish. Please make yourselves at home. If you have anything you need, please let Pemmi know.]

Pemmi: [I can get you anything you need, other than pollen pemmicans. Those are for me. Shall we go?]

stone henge 2.title: Stone Henge Home
stone henge 2.text:
Pemmi leads you to the guest house, which was on another stone brick below the temple. There are no walls other than the doorway, and the room has a view as nice as the temple's.

Pemmi: [I'll bring you dinner soon. Holler if you need anything else.]

Cheese collapses on the stone floor and stops moving.

Cheese: [Finally... rest.]

Scobby: [It's nice here. I really like the priest, and the servant Pemmi. I have a good feeling about this.]

stone henge 3.text:
You wake up with a severe headache.
It is dark.

You try to move, but you realize that your hands are tied behind you.
You try to say something, but you are muffled.
Someone muffles you back... it sounds like Cheese.

stone henge 4.text:
You say: *muffle muffle*

Cheese: [*muffle* *muffle*]

You think Cheese just said: 'Why are you muffled?'

You and Cheese muffle back and forth for about ten minutes.
You do not sense Scobby's presence nearby.

stone henge 5.text:
You get up and touch around the room with your tied hands. It looks like you are in a small enclosed room.
You sit back down beside Cheese.

Hours pass...

Your buttocks hurt from sitting on stone floor for so long.

Suddenly, you hear footsteps and see faint light.
A door opens, and a muscular person looking like one of the guards of Stone Henge comes into the room, accompanied by magical light.

He casts a spell on you and Cheese.

stone henge 6.title: Stone Henge?
stone henge 6.text:
You vaguely remember leaving Stone Henge, guided by a few guards with spell lights.
You walk through the woods, but you don't remember how long.

It's all like a dream...

stone henge 7.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 7.text:
Scobby: [WAKE UP, GODDAMMIT!]

You snap out of your hypnosis.
You look around.

You see Cheese beside you, just as confused as you are.
In front of you stands Scobby with a knife in his hands. It looks like he just cut you free from your hand binding.

Scobby: [We gotta get out of here, right now!]

You look around quickly. It looks like you are in a spider nest. Further down the webbed halls you spot someone who looks like Pemmi, wielding a staff and accompanied by spell light.

Pemmi: [I sense another one coming. We can't run from it, so let's kill it quick!]

stone henge 8-1.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 8-1.text:
You collapse. You see Pemmi casting her magic and Scobby taking down the last spider.

Scobby: [Can you walk? we gotta get out of here!]

Cheese: [What the hell? Where are we?]

Scobby: [No time to explain. Let's be as quick and quiet as possible. Follow me!]

Pemmi gives you a quick heal with her magic and Scobby drags you out.

stone henge 8-2.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 8-2.text:
Scobby: [Alright, let's move!]

Pemmi gives you a quick heal with her magic.

Cheese: [What the hell? Where are we?]

Scobby: [No time to explain. Let's be as quick and quiet as possible. Follow me!]

stone henge 9.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 9.text:
You try to move quickly through the tunnels, but every surface is covered with sticky spiderwebs. You have to stop and scrape off spiderwebs from under your feet every once in a while.

Pemmi: [Another one, be ready!]

stone henge 10.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 10.text:
Pemmi: [Take out your knife, that's the exit!]

You break through a spiderweb covering and reach the surface.
You are met with morning light seeping through the canopy of a forest.

Your group continue on for hours, constantly looking back in paranoia.

Cheese: [Guys, I can't walk anymore. Please, what is going on?]

Pemmi: [I think we are far enough, let's find a place to rest nearby...]

stone henge 11.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 11.text:
You set up camp in the middle of a field full of goldenrod flowers, completely hidden from sight.

Scobby: [I don't know where to start... bear with me.]

Scobby: [*Sigh*
It looks like the priest of Stone Henge had ordered his men to capture us and offer us as some kind of tribute to the wolf spiders.]

Cheese: [Huh?]

Scobby: [I.. had sneaked out last night to talk to Pemmi. I talked to her about our Full Moon's Journey, and she told me that Stone Henge had received guests from Ant Hill almost every month. I knew something was wrong...]

Cheese: [What are you saying? They received guests from Ant Hill?]

Scobby: [Yes. And they've done to them what they've done to us today. And that's why no one ever returned to Ant Hill.]

Cheese: [What? no, no, no... Are you telling me all those people sent out actually died?]

Cheese entered a state of panic.

Cheese: [I was sure they all found a better place and abandoned shitty Ant Hill... I didn't sign up for this...]

Scobby looked at Cheese with frustration.

Pemmi: [...I've only been the priest's hand for two months, but I know that we get a lot of visitors from Ant Hill. I've met one by the name of Arly last month. The priest had told me that she had returned to Ant Hill, but now I don't know...]

opt.text: We should return to Ant Hill and get help!

stone henge 12.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 12.text:
Scobby: [I agree. We should return at once. The priest is probably desperately trying to catch us. And also...]

Scobby: [Pemmi, I'm so sorry, but I don't think it's safe for you here anymore. We should move together.]

Pemmi nods.

Cheese: [Wait... Can I stay here? My legs just... I can't... never mind.]
